subject: An undercity ratcatcher in pixel art. The torso is in a front three-quarter view; the head and the feet are in profile and point to screen-right. One trouser leg has a brown patch and the other trouser leg has a grey patch. One hand holds a short hooked blade; the other hand is empty.
action: The ratcatcher does a game walk cycle, like a walk on a treadmill. He takes two equal steps, one with each leg. Each foot swings forward low above the ground, lands on the heel in front of the body, then slides back below the body. The body moves up and down a little with each step. The knees stay low. The arms swing a little, opposite to the legs.

beats.pose: the leg with the brown patch swings forward past the other leg and lands on its heel in front, while the foot of the leg with the grey patch slides back behind the body; the blade hand swings to the front and the empty hand swings behind
